units.source_text: 愿得拜见尊颜，面陈衷曲。”

en.t: I wish to behold your honored face and speak my true feelings to you in person.

units.source_text: 夫人想见他已知道浮舟是八亲王血统，她就越发希望她和二女公子同样地嫁个身份高贵的人了。

en.t: The lady supposed that he already knew Ukifune was of the Eighth Prince's bloodline, and she wished all the more that Ukifune, like the second young lady, might marry a man of noble rank.

units.source_text: 于是薰大将的姿态风貌不由地浮现在她眼前。

en.t: Then the figure and bearing of General Kaoru rose unbidden before her eyes.

units.source_text: 她想：“匂亲王和薰大将一样俊美，然而我对此人一开始就断念了，不把他放在心上了。

en.t: She thought, Prince Niou is as handsome as General Kaoru, but from the beginning I gave up all thought of him and put him out of my mind.

units.source_text: 他欺侮浮舟，擅自闯入室中，想起了深可痛恨。

en.t: He slighted Ukifune and forced his way into her room; the memory of it is deeply hateful.

units.source_text: 薰大将有心追求浮舟，毕竟不曾唐突地启口，表面上若无其事，真是很难得的。

en.t: General Kaoru had feelings for Ukifune, yet in the end he never spoke rashly of them and outwardly behaved as if nothing were amiss; that is truly rare.

units.source_text: 我尚且常常想起他，何况青年女子，安得不恋恋于心？

en.t: Even I often think of him, so how could a young woman fail to keep him fondly in her heart?

units.source_text: 像少将这种可厌的人，如果当真做了浮舟的夫婿，真乃太没面子了。”

en.t: If a detestable man like the Lesser Captain truly became Ukifune's husband, it would be unbearably humiliating.

units.source_text: 她只管为浮舟之事操心担忧，有时想这样，有时想那样，

en.t: She could only worry and fret over Ukifune's affairs, now thinking one thing and now another,

units.source_text: 千方百计为她考虑善策，但实行起来困难得很。

en.t: trying every possible way to devise a good plan for her, though carrying any of it out would be extremely difficult.

units.source_text: 因为她想：“薰大将看惯了二公主那样身份高贵的人，

en.t: For she thought, General Kaoru is accustomed to seeing women of such noble rank as the Second Princess,

units.source_text: 即使有品貌优于浮舟的女子，怕也不容易使他动心吧。

en.t: so even if there were a woman superior to Ukifune in character and beauty, it would probably not be easy to move his heart.

units.source_text: 我在世间见闻所及，人的容貌和品性的优劣，往往根据其人身份的高低而定。

en.t: From what I have seen and heard in the world, the merits of a person's looks and character are often judged according to the height of that person's rank.

units.source_text: 试看我的子女，常陆守所生的总赶不上八亲王所生的这个浮舟。

en.t: Look at my own children: those born to the Governor of Hitachi can never match this Ukifune, who was born to the Eighth Prince.

units.source_text: 又如这个少将，在常陆守邸内看来品貌优越无比，但和匂亲王一比较就相形见绌。

en.t: And this Lesser Captain, for example, seems unmatched in bearing and appearance within the Governor of Hitachi's household, but when compared with Prince Niou he pales by comparison.
From this one can probably infer everything else.

units.source_text: 薰大将已得当今皇上的爱女为妻，恐怕在他看来，浮舟粗陋可耻，毫无足取吧。”

en.t: General Kaoru has already taken the present Emperor's beloved daughter as his wife; in his eyes, I fear, Ukifune must seem coarse, shameful, and worth nothing at all.

units.source_text: 如此一想，不禁心灰意懒，茫然若失了。

en.t: Thinking this, she could not help losing heart and spirit, and she sat dazed as though bereft of something.
